fields.explanation: The source permitsa=0 andx>|a|, while the secant substitution requires representingx=|a|secθ. Keepa=0,x=1. Noθwithcosθnonzero can give1=0·secθ. Actual real numbers, absolute value and cosine. Uses the failed reverse equation to avoid falsely treating Lean total division as undefined.
fields.flaw: The substitution sec(theta)=x/|a| is valid and domain-preserving under the stated hypotheses without requiring a≠0.
fields.problem:
Title: Integral Resulting in Arcsecant

:<nowiki>$\ds \int \frac 1 {x \sqrt {x^2 - a^2} } \rd x = \begin{cases}
\dfrac 1 {\size a} \arcsec \dfrac x {\size a} + C & : x > \size a \\
-\dfrac 1 {\size a} \arcsec \dfrac x {\size a} + C & : x < -\size a
\end{cases}$</nowiki>

where $a$ is a [[Definition:Constant|constant]].
fields.witness: Take real a=0 and x=1. There are no stated hypotheses excluding this choice. Then |a|=0, so the proposed expression sec(theta)=x/|a| requires the ordinary-real quotient 1/0 and is undefined. Equivalently, the reverse parametrization x=|a|sec(theta) gives x=0 for every theta where sec(theta) is defined, so it cannot represent x=1.
